input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
errors: A parallel background launch of two coda-check runs lost the second one: its output directory did not exist yet when its redirect opened; rerun serially (cost ~14 min).
venture-preflight's first run failed check_cli_entry.py on eval/release-cells.mjs (a file:// string entry guard); fixed with pathToFileURL, second preflight clean.

doc_friction.issue: Run without --opt it reads with readCoda's defaults, not coda-check's MODES ({lipShut:true}); its hits and misses on part c disagreed with the report until --opt '{"lipShut":true}' was passed.
2,800 lines; the coda-reader rounds fill ~1,450 of them, so finding the current state of one item takes grep plus several reads.

deviations.why: The buildable item asked for a coda-reader rule for cluster-onset -um; frame-by-frame reading showed the fault is in the synthesis (murmur darkness follows the onset lead / beat phase), so no reader rule was registered.
deviations.did: Shipped the diagnosis (cluster-um-diag + report), an opt-in reference rule (longTilt) measured on every part, and a reader-free cell selector for the next held-out part; rewrote buildable/next to point at sing.mjs and a registration.
deviations.result: Item re-scoped with evidence; default reader unchanged (report byte-identical).

notes: Verification: python3 platform/ci/run_venture_tests.py chant-forge -> ok (318 tests); eval/coda-check.mjs default run byte-identical to the committed report; --long-tilt on diffed against it (README numbers); post front matter/links/similarity checks clean; portfolio/router/validate.py clean. node platform/pages/venture-preflight.mjs chant-forge -> preflight clean (second run).

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: an audio DSP engineer diagnosing a synthesiser/reader interaction: two full eval runs, two diagnostics, one rule and tests

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
